summary.zh: 先堆暴击，再堆连击点：恶意、击杀后几乎必暴的第一击，以及把连击点还回来的无情。
summary.en: Critical strike first, then combo points: Malice, a near-guaranteed crit after every kill, and Ruthlessness feeding the next finisher.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，用邪恶攻击与刺骨快速单刷
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, fast solo kills with Sinister Strike and Eviscerate

pros.zh: 恶意让所有攻击与毒药的暴击几率提高 5%。
pros.en: Malice adds 5% critical strike chance with all attacks and poisons.

pros.zh: 冷酷攻击让击杀后的第一次攻击获得 40% 额外暴击几率，任务怪可以一只接一只地连下去。
pros.en: Remorseless Attacks gives a 40% critical strike chance on your first strike after a kill, which chains quest mobs together.

pros.zh: 无情让终结技有 60% 几率直接返还 1 个连击点。
pros.en: Ruthlessness gives finishing moves a 60% chance to hand a combo point straight back.

pros.zh: 无情打击让终结技有 20% 几率按消耗的每个连击点回复 25 点能量。
pros.en: Relentless Strikes returns 25 Energy per combo point spent, 20% of the time.

pros.zh: 来源指南的第 11 点没有分配；我们放进无情打击，因为 20 级潜行者的瓶颈是能量而不是伤害。
pros.en: The source guide leaves the eleventh point unspent; we put it in Relentless Strikes because Energy, not damage, is what limits a level-20 Rogue.

pros.zh: 强化切割被刻意跳过：这个等级的怪活不到让持续时间产生价值。
pros.en: Improved Slice and Dice is skipped on purpose: nothing at this level lives long enough to pay for the duration.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
